name: customer-spotlight
purpose: A row of client cards, each painted in the client's own colours with its reversed logo; the hovered or focused card opens to reveal its story line and a "Read story" cue, and the whole card links to the success story. Below the large breakpoint the cards stack and stay open. From the design sample's site `CustomerSpotlight`.
useWhen: Three or four flagship customer stories on a landing page.
bestPractices: Use the client's reversed (white) logo; the face paints the client's brand colours.

Leave `brand` out for a client the client registry knows (`clientBrand(name)` from `@aziontech/webkit/assets/client-registry`): the card reads its colours by `name`. Add a missing client to the registry rather than writing its hex colours into the page. Pass `brand` only for a one-off client the registry does not carry; a card with neither paints a black face.

props.name: cards
props.doc: The cards, in reading order; each is `{ name, logo, logoWidth?, href, description, brand? }`; `brand` (`{ base, glow }`) defaults to the client registry's colours for `name`. A card opens while hovered or focused.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the list; empty uses the built-in "Customer stories".

props.name: storyLabel
props.doc: Label revealed under the description while the card is open; empty uses the built-in "Read story".

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a hash link can target it.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import agibankExtendedReversed from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/agibank-extended-reversed.svg'
  import americanasExtendedReversed from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/americanas-extended-reversed.svg'
  import arezzoExtendedReversed from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/arezzo-extended-reversed.svg'
  import CustomerSpotlight from '@aziontech/webkit/customer-spotlight'

  const cards = [
    {
      name: 'Agibank',
      logo: agibankExtendedReversed,
      href: '/customers/agibank',
      description: 'Agibank moved its digital bank to a platform that scales with every campaign.'
    },
    {
      name: 'Americanas',
      logo: americanasExtendedReversed,
      href: '/customers/americanas',
      description: 'Americanas serves Black Friday traffic with no capacity planning.'
    },
    {
      name: 'Arezzo',
      logo: arezzoExtendedReversed,
      href: '/customers/arezzo',
      description: 'Arezzo cut image weight by half across its storefronts.'
    }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <CustomerSpotlight :cards="cards" />
</template>
